besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subjects (''n Voertuig is' / 'elke deel doen').
besluite.rede: Two full clauses joined by 'en' take the AWS comma; meaning unchanged.
'Dan' already reads naturally as 'in that case' after the axle holds the wheel upright; 'So' is a lateral swap of a linking particle.

besluite.fout: 'rol van die voertuig af weg' stacks particles stiffly; 'dra niks' is acceptable but the closing 'nie' matches the lesson's own 'dra geen vrag nie'.
besluite.rede: 'rol weg van die voertuig af en dra niks nie' is the natural Afrikaans order, with the same meaning.

besluite.fout: Without the comma 'oor die vloer en sy hele onderkant' can be misread as one list of what is dragged.
besluite.rede: The imperative and the clause with its own subject 'sy hele onderkant' are two main clauses, so the comma applies and removes a stumble.
The original is the natural order and no reader takes 'n wiel met kryt' as a chalky wheel; the proposal is stiffer.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining 'staan die as stil' and 'die wiel draai om hom', each with its own subject and verb.
besluite.rede: Two full clauses joined by 'en' take the AWS comma; meaning unchanged.

besluite.fout: 'By albei maniere' is not an idiomatic Afrikaans expression.
besluite.rede: 'In albei gevalle' is the natural fixed expression and still refers to the same two designs.
The original order already flows, and the proposal actually separates 'elke keer' from its 'as'-clause, the opposite of its stated reason.

besluite.fout: 'iets' followed by 'die deel' leaves the reader unsure whether the two refer to the same thing.
besluite.rede: 'n deel ... daardie deel' makes the reference clear while staying general enough to cover either the wheel or the axle, so the meaning is unchanged.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining 'Jy tel hom op' and 'hy voel', each with its own subject and verb.
besluite.rede: Two full clauses joined by 'en' take the AWS comma; the protected sentence after it is untouched.
